resolution: Audited the exact -81-line correction commit and the full pre-to-post migration Zig surface against the cited Zig 0.16 float-language idioms. Confirmed that the migration intentionally adopted structural 0.16 APIs (explicit std.Io, Group, Queue, std.Io.net, process.Init), but did not perform a language-ergonomics pass: float builtin result forwarding was not introduced, direct floor/ceil/round/trunc-to-integer typing was not introduced, deprecated @intFromFloat remains widespread, and small safe integer-to-float coercions were not intentionally adopted. No code changed.
